user_agents.name: OAI-SearchBot
user_agents.purpose: Surface websites in ChatGPT search results
user_agents.scope: Crawls content for ChatGPT search features; sites opted out won't appear in search answers
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow OAI-SearchBot in robots.txt; opt-out takes ~24 hours to propagate

user_agents.name: OAI-AdsBot
user_agents.purpose: Validate safety of web pages submitted as ads on ChatGPT
user_agents.scope: Only visits pages submitted as ads; validates compliance and determines ad relevance
user_agents.opt_out: User agent can be disallowed via robots.txt

user_agents.name: GPTBot
user_agents.purpose: Training data collection for generative AI foundation models
user_agents.scope: Crawls content for training OpenAI's generative AI models; disallow indicates content should not be used for training
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow GPTBot in robots.txt to prevent use in training generative AI foundation models

user_agents.name: ChatGPT-User
user_agents.purpose: User-triggered web access for ChatGPT queries and Custom GPT actions
user_agents.scope: Visits web pages when users ask ChatGPT questions or interact with external apps via GPT Actions; not automatic crawling
user_agents.opt_out: robots.txt rules may not apply; not used for Search; use OAI-SearchBot for managing crawl opt-outs

user_agents.name: ClaudeBot
user_agents.purpose: Collect web content for AI model training and development
user_agents.scope: General web crawl for gathering training data to enhance utility and safety of generative AI models
user_agents.opt_out: User-agent: ClaudeBot / Disallow: / (or use Crawl-delay directive in robots.txt)

user_agents.name: Claude-User
user_agents.purpose: Retrieve web content for user-initiated requests and live responses
user_agents.scope: User-triggered fetch when individuals ask questions to Claude and request web access
user_agents.opt_out: User-agent: Claude-User / Disallow: / in robots.txt to prevent retrieval of your content

user_agents.name: Claude-SearchBot
user_agents.purpose: Index web content to improve search result quality and relevance
user_agents.scope: Web crawl to analyze content and enhance relevance and accuracy of search responses
user_agents.opt_out: User-agent: Claude-SearchBot / Disallow: / in robots.txt to prevent indexing for search

user_agents.name: Googlebot
user_agents.purpose: Build Google Search indexes for search results
user_agents.scope: General web crawl for Google Search, Discover, Images, Video, News

user_agents.name: Googlebot-Image
user_agents.purpose: Index images for Google Images and Search image features
user_agents.scope: Image URLs across web for Images, Discover, Video, Google Search

user_agents.name: Googlebot-Video
user_agents.purpose: Index videos for video-related Google Search features
user_agents.scope: Video content for video-related Search features and dependent products

user_agents.name: Googlebot-News
user_agents.purpose: Index content for Google News product and news.google.com
user_agents.scope: News content for Google News product and Google News app

user_agents.name: Storebot-Google

user_agents.scope: Shopping content for Google Shopping, Shopping tab in Search

user_agents.name: Google-InspectionTool
user_agents.purpose: Support Google Search testing and inspection tools

user_agents.name: GoogleOther

user_agents.name: GoogleOther-Image

user_agents.scope: Publicly accessible image URLs for various internal purposes

user_agents.name: GoogleOther-Video

user_agents.name: Google-CloudVertexBot

user_agents.name: Google-Extended

user_agents.name: PerplexityBot

user_agents.name: Perplexity-User

user_agents.scope: User-triggered fetch to visit web pages when users ask questions, generally ignores robots.txt
user_agents.opt_out: Configure WAF rules or robots.txt to restrict Perplexity-User access via User-Agent header matching

user_agents.name: Applebot
